assumptions: The two named FLAME sections share the1990–2002 monthly-output mean and core definition.
A nominal equatorial connector provides distance/display context only; the source core lies slightly south of the equator and its exact latitude is not recovered.
Intermediate core depth is an assumed linear trend in reference distance, rounded10m for display; no extrapolation west of35W or east of10W.
Observed100m and SPFLAME100m at35W remain separate comparisons and are excluded from interpolation.
No vertical thickness, width pairing, annual extrema or volume is inferred.
